options.text: What are you doing up here? It doesn't seem very safe.

steps.player: What are you doing up here? It doesn't seem very safe.

steps.npc: On the contrary, it would not be safe if we were not up here!
You see, that creature up there has a powerful divine energy about it. That energy is used to protect itself and interfere with our own divine capabilities.

steps.player: Divine capabilities? You mean praying to the gods?

steps.npc: Praying? Yes. To the gods? That is open to interpretation.
I do not have the time nor desire to explain the advanced concepts of theology to you, but you should know that the Dwarves of Cam Torum take a different approach to worship than your kind.
Anyway, the point is that without experienced seers to aid you, you may find yourself unable to utilise your prayers as you normally would.

steps.player: Interesting. So we need to work together to subdue this creature?

steps.npc: Indeed, just follow our lead and you'll be fine... probably.
Good. If you have any further questions about your role here, speak to Taala.

options.text: Could I trade some tomes in?

steps.player: Could I trade some tomes in?

steps.npc: You can't trade in zero of an item.

steps.text: If the player inputs more than 1:

steps.prompt: Trade in 1x Tome of Earth (empty) for 250x soiled pages?

steps.text: You trade 1x Tome of Earth (empty) for some soiled pages.

steps.npc: Block its attacks with your prayers!
Let's convince that beastie to move!

overhead-dialogue-completing-the-body-ph.text: The seer runs to the Hueycoatl's tail that's blocking the path.
The Hueycoatl's tail moves, clearing a path to the top of the mountain.
The seer runs towards the three pillars.

overhead-dialogue-upon-reaching-the-thre.npc: Keep praying to bolster your strength!

overhead-dialogue-throughout-the-rest-of.npc: Keep praying to charge the pillars!

overhead-dialogue-throughout-the-head-an.npc: Show that beastie what we're made of!

overhead-dialogue-after-charging-up-enou.text: If one of the three pillars isn't charged up:

steps.npc: We need to charge all of the pillars using our prayers!

overhead-dialogue-after-charging-up-enou.text: If all three pillars are charged up:

steps.npc: Excellent! The pillars are boosting your strength!
Well done! The power of the pillars is yours!

overhead-dialogue-when-the-tail-phase-st.npc: It's shielded itself! You need to break its concentration!

steps.npc: Go for the tail! It's a weakspot!

overhead-dialogue-as-the-final-phase-sta.npc: Well done! Now, let's weaken it a little more!
